topicName: What is JPA (Java Persistence API) and what problem does it solve?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is JPA (Java Persistence API) and what problem does it solve?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"JPA (Java Persistence API) is a specification that simplifies data persistence in Java applications. It provides an object-relational mapping (ORM) layer, allowing developers to interact with databases using Java objects instead of writing raw SQL queries. JPA solves the impedance mismatch between object-oriented programming and relational databases, improving developer productivity and code maintainability."}]
